about: S-exercise-detail - the undrawn states of Gyakorlat részletei (PLAN 4.1 rule 7). The two frame states (exercise-detail-1 / -2) stay as pulse-frames.json declares them: account M, the recorded detail of the bench press and of the pull-ups. The moderation states are LIVE rows of the seed read as their author (account C = coach@, seed-demo.mjs): 1657 Demó – Bolgár kitörés (pending, image, front + back muscles), 1658 Demó – Kötélhúzás ülve (pending, image, back-only muscles = the dark Elöl view), 1660 Demó – Névtelen gépes gyakorlat (rejected with the moderator reason, nothing tagged). Literal ids are the ids of this freeze (no resolve entry exists for them in pulse-frames.json; a reseed needs new ids). Two states are edit lists over the recorded bench press (R26). The page is read-only: no state writes.

exercise-detail-1.why: the back control is named by its key (nav.library), so the same assertion holds in en / de; the markup is the same link

exercise-detail-2.why: names by key (nav.library, muscleMap.back) so the en / de runs arrive too; the switch is the kit Segmented (role radio, aria-checked)

ed-loading.title: Gyakorlat részletei — betöltés (nem szám azonosító)
ed-loading.why: undrawn: the loading skeleton. A non-numeric id keeps the query disabled (known defect, unchanged), which is the one way to hold the loading state in a replay; a numeric id answers at once.

ed-not-found.title: Gyakorlat részletei — nem található
ed-not-found.why: undrawn: the live 404 of an id that does not exist (the same state a failed read and a forbidden row land in - known defect, unchanged)

ed-rejected.title: Gyakorlat részletei — elutasított beküldés indoklással
ed-rejected.why: undrawn: the author opens a rejected submission - the danger notice with the moderator reason under the header; no muscles, no equipment, two steps, no substitutes; text not translated (translated 0, no other language) -> the EN mark

ed-pending.title: Gyakorlat részletei — ellenőrzésre vár, képpel
ed-pending.why: undrawn: a submission waiting for review - the info notice line; the uploaded image takes its block between the header and the stage and Eszköz is not shown (unchanged rule); front + back muscles

ed-dark-view.title: Gyakorlat részletei — minden célizom a hátul nézetben
ed-dark-view.why: undrawn: every highlighted muscle is on the back (lats + rear delts) - on Elöl the figure stands unlit, the role key and the other-side caption stay

ed-description.title: Gyakorlat részletei — csak leírás, lépések nélkül
ed-description.why: undrawn: no steps but a description - one paragraph under a strong rule, no heading (R22: no invented heading)
